newsitem.title: USA: Techs, concerns about upcoming data dampen Nasdaq.
newsitem.headline: Techs, concerns about upcoming data dampen Nasdaq.

text.p: Nasdaq shares slipped further Monday, pulled lower by losses in key technology stocks and jitters about upcoming economic data, traders said.

The Nasdaq composite index, which resisted a late recovery in the broader market, lost 10.06 points or 0.63 percent to close unofficially at 1588.46. Declining issues beat gainers 2401 to 1884 on total volume of 622 million shares.
Ascend Communications Inc, the most active Nasdaq issue, lost 4-12/16 to 44-11/16 after it said it said it earned a lower-than-expected $2.9 million in July.

With high-flying valuations and recent gains, technology stocks have become particulary susceptible to market fluctuations, analysts said. Industry bellwethers Intel Corp, Dell Computer Corp and Microsoft Corp all showed losses. Apple Computer Inc also slipped amid a downgrade by A.G. Edwards.

Traders expect investors to remain cautious on Tuesday, ahead of retail sales and producer price index reports due on Wednesday. "Tomorrow will be more of today, until we see the numbers come out on Wednesday," said Nelson Gold, senior vice president of over-the-counter trading at Interstate-Johnson Lane Corp.
